messages.subject: Solved: knitr syntax higlighting of file-stored stan code!
parts:
I couldn't find anyone else posting this solution, so I thought I'd share what I came up with. You simply need to do:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
writeLines(
c(
'```{stan, output.var="mod"}'
, readLines('my_stan_model.stan')
,'```'
)
, con = 'my_stan_model.Rmd'
)
```
```{r , child = 'my_stan_model.Rmd'}
```

Note 1: If you're using an RStudio R Notebook, the stan code won't render in the notebook view but will render in the .nb.html file.

Note2: Running the latter chunk will trigger compilation of the model, stored for access from R in the object "mod".
